frequency_question: What proportion of major central industrial/transport subsidy schemes are fully finalized and gazetted within 12 months of initial conceptual drafting?
membership_rule: Includes all centrally sponsored schemes involving financial subsidies and credit guarantees for manufacturing sectors managed by major economic ministries (Heavy Industries, Commerce, Finance) initiated between 2015 and 2025; excludes minor administrative circulars and non-financial advisory guidelines.

cases.name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Auto & Auto Components
PLI Advanced Chemistry Cell Battery Storage
Spearhead Capital Goods Scheme Phase II

coverage_note: 8 named cases representing a representative sample of major industrial policy notifications by the Ministry of Heavy Industries and related economic ministries.
known_gaps: Some minor sub-schemes or internal pilot programs may not be fully tracked in public gazette archives.
skeleton: Total major industrial schemes identified in window divided by those meeting the 12-month completion threshold from inception to gazette notification.
validity_reason: Bureaucratic rulemaking procedures and standard inter-ministerial consultation timeframes under the Government of India Allocation of Business Rules remain stable over multi-year periods.
